counterexample.operation: rename allowed stage directory, create a new directory at the original pathname, then let the already-confined child write through the original path
counterexample.observed: child successfully created a synthetic underlay file in the replacement directory
counterexample.implication: pathname-based Seatbelt grants do not bind Cargo-style writes to the mounted volume identity across detach; the sampled mount UUID check cannot close the check-to-write race

decision.route: NO-GO for this unprivileged pathname-based Seatbelt approach on the owner Mac
decision.next_possible_gate: demonstrate kernel-enforced mount identity or use a separate unprivileged identity that cannot access the underlay, then separately review exact source/cache closure
decision.limitations: This does not establish that every possible confinement architecture is impossible.
